question: The Green Revolution started in the year 1965 and the __________ five year plan was between 1961-1966.
solution:
The correct answer is __**3rd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Green Revolution in India started in the year **1965**.
 
• The **3rd Five-Year Plan** was between **1961-1966**.
 
• The Green Revolution aimed to increase agricultural production through the use of high-yield variety seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation.
 
• This revolution led to a significant increase in food grain production, especially in states like Punjab, Haryana, and Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The success of the Green Revolution made India self-sufficient in food grains and transformed the country from a food-deficient to a food-surplus nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **First Five-Year Plan** was from 1951 to 1956, focusing on the agricultural sector.
 
• The **Second Five-Year Plan** (1956-1961) emphasized industrialization.
 
• The **Third Five-Year Plan** (1961-1966) aimed at making India self-reliant and self-generating in food grains.
 
• The Green Revolution was a part of the third plan and continued into the subsequent plans.
 
• It involved the introduction of new agricultural technologies and practices to increase productivity and ensure food security.
